title: Better Village
description: A hardcore overhaul mod that changes classic mechanics and adds new ores, biomes, and dungeons.
body:
This mod changes classic Minecraft mechanics and adds new ores, biomes, and dungeons to make the game much harder. Gathering bark and sticks from trees is just the start of a more realistic and challenging survival experience.

The mod is currently in BETA, so some features are still being tested and developed.
